messages:
Maya R.: Heads up — saw a weird provisional token spike for acct:acct-42 around 12:17 UTC today when the router retried into eu-1 fallback. :eyes:
Arjun K.: saw that too, was looking at the ledger. provisional tokens jumped ~1.8x for a burst of reconnects.
Leo S.: do you have request ids? might be a duplicate attribution between original route and fallback.
Maya R.: request ids: rQe-9f2 / rQe-9f3. trace shows initial route -> us-west but failed, retried to eu-1. console shows provisional on us-west, final charge in eu-1.
Tina Ops: that mismatch is the UX pain — console only shows final confirmed region in the charge table, provisional counts are aggregated to the original route token bucket. customers see >100% variance.
Arjun K.: digging: internal-router emits events: {"attempt":0,"route":"us-west","provisional_tokens":52} then attempt 1 -> {"route":"eu-1","confirmed_tokens":52}. ledger currently stores provisional by initial attempt key.
Jamie (deploy-bot): deployed tracer v2 yesterday. Any chance the tracer changed idp semantics? :thinking:
sre-bot: tracer v2 adds session_salt which can change attempt keys when reconnect happens across region. That would break provisional grouping.
Leo S.: so we have two separate attribution keys: provisional tied to pre-salt key, confirmed tied to salted session id. Means provisional never reconciles and shows up as a ghost charge in the dashboard.
Maya R.: ok. short-term mitigation: can we show "fallbacked routes" in the provisional breakdown so console makes it explicit? even if counts double, at least customers understand routing path.
Tina Ops: agree. small UX change: add column "attempted route(s)" in provisional tab and a tooltip: "includes tokens allocated before fallbacks or retries."
Arjun K.: low-effort backend fix: when confirmed arrives, do a reconciliation pass that looks for provisional entries with same user/request within window (10s) ignoring session_salt and merge. ugly but reduces noise.
Leo S.: merging must be careful — we can't undercharge if there were real duplicates. maybe only auto-merge when confirmed_tokens == provisional_tokens and confirmed_status==ok.
Maya R.: also add a metric in the telemetry: provisional_reconcile_failures per route-pair so we can measure how often this is happening.
Jamie (deploy-bot): rolling patch candidate: router: emit attempt_chain metadata (array of routes) and ledger: keep provisional with attempt_chain hash so reconciliation can match across salted ids.
Tina Ops: timeline? ops wants visibility in console for customer calls tomorrow.
Arjun K.: I can spike reconciliation patch now (1-2 hrs) and add a lightweight console flag to surface attempt_chain for provisional rows (no full UI change).
Leo S.: I'll add alerting to telemetry for provisional vs confirmed delta > 20% per customer.
Maya R.: sweet. one more ask: add an example in the billing FAQ explaining retries and provisional counts — saves support tickets.
Tina Ops: agreed. I'll draft the FAQ snippet after patch lands.
Arjun K.: status: starting patch. will post logs here when ready.
Maya R.: thanks. :thumbsup:
Jamie (deploy-bot): deploy queued for canary in 30m.
Arjun K.: quick log sample (local repro):
```
INFO router: attempt=0 route=us-west req=rQe-9f2 provisional_tokens=48
WARN router: attempt=1 route=eu-1 req=rQe-9f2 confirmed_tokens=48
INFO ledger: provisional_record: user=acct-42 key=pre-salt-7 tokens=48
INFO ledger: confirmed_record: user=acct-42 key=post-salt-d tokens=48
```
Leo S.: leaving this thread pinned to the incident channel for now and will follow up after reconciliation metrics land.
Tina Ops: will update support playbook.
Maya R.: closing loop — thanks everyone.
